package.name: nros_serdes
package.description:
CDR serialization for nano-ros — and, since phase-421 W4, the package that ANNOUNCES it.
RFC-0087 D1: a package is a directory with a package.xml, so this file is what makes the crate discoverable at all. RFC-0088 D6: the `serdes` family joins `rmw`, `board` and `platform`, and the `nano_ros_provides` export below is what a source-time scan reads. What it lowers to is declared in the sibling `nros-serdes.toml` descriptor, read only when this provider is the one selected.
The descriptor sits beside the crate that implements the format rather than in a metadata-only package: a provider that announces a format nothing here implements would be a name with no code behind it.
